findings.title: CVE-2026-86155: Apache Jena Fuseki: SHACL validation can cause SSRF in SHACL SPARQL targets
findings.summary_md: Apache Jena developer Andy Seaborne posted the CVE-2026-86155 advisory to oss-security at 22:03 UTC on 23 November 2026. The advisory says SHACL validation in Apache Jena Fuseki through 6.2.0 can cause server-side request forgery through SHACL SPARQL targets, and rates it CVSS 4.0 10.0 with network attack vector, no privileges required and no user interaction. Users are told to upgrade to Fuseki 6.3.0. The finding credit names MopMonk-AI and Immanuel Tikhonov.

findings.title: CVE-2026-124324: Apache Jena Fuseki: SERVICE bypasses localhost-only administration controls
findings.summary_md: A second Apache Jena advisory posted to oss-security on 23 November 2026 says SERVICE operations in Fuseki through 6.2.0 can bypass restrictions on administration operations. Apache rates the issue critical and names 6.3.0 as the fixed release. The report credits Abhishek Kushwaha. The advisory does not state that this issue has been exploited.

findings.title: CVE-2026-86156: Apache Jena Fuseki: Web requests using SPARQL Update can escape file restrictions for graph data
findings.summary_md: Apache's 23 November 2026 oss-security notice for CVE-2026-86156 describes a path traversal issue in Fuseki through 6.2.0 that lets SPARQL Update access data from the local server. Apache classifies the flaw as important and recommends upgrading to 6.3.0. Credit is given to Kyle /EY of China, MopMonk-AI, Frederic Pidancier of GAEL Systems and Huy Bui.

findings.title: CVE-2026-86155: Apache Jena Fuseki: SHACL validation can cause SSRF in SHACL SPARQL targets
findings.summary_md: Cyber Security News published a short item at 00:15 CET on 24 November 2026, which is 23:15 UTC on 23 November, summarizing the oss-security disclosure of CVE-2026-86155. It repeats the CVSS 4.0 score of 10.0, the affected range of Apache Jena Fuseki through 6.2.0, and the fixed version 6.3.0. The page states that it excerpted the original advisory and did not independently report or verify the underlying story.
